site.summary: harborwallet-mobile Fictional consumer wallet "Harbor Wallet" iOS-style phone fixture. Single-page app simulating a 390 × 844 device frame with notch, status bar, home indicator, and tab bar. UXBench fixture in the Mobile Micro-UI category. Layout - **Phone chassis** — 12 px chrome + radial gradient backdrop. Renders edge-to-edge on actual mobile (≤460 px viewport). - **Status bar** — live ticking time (rounded down to minutes), signal bars, wifi, battery (78%). - **Tab bar** (bottom) — 5 tabs: Home / Send / Receive / Activity / Account. run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore the Harbor Wallet mobile fixture, focusing on the Account/Settings flow (specifically Privacy), validating core transactional paths (Send/Receive), and critiquing UX accessibility issues identified in the prescan.
run_plan.summary: The run will begin by establishing the baseline Home state, then navigate to the 'Account' tab to locate and exercise the Settings/Privacy controls. It will subsequently validate the primary 'Send' and 'Receive' flows to ensure functional consistency. Finally, it will switch to a mobile viewport to re-evaluate tap targets and layout constraints flagged as risks.
assumptions: The application is a Single Page Application (SPA) where navigation updates the DOM dynamically rather than loading new HTML files.
The 'Account' tab contains the entry point for 'Settings' and 'Privacy' configurations.
The '3 🔔' notification badge implies an interactive notification center or message list.
risk_hotspots: Notification Bell (ux-1): 38x38px tap target is below the 44px mobile accessibility standard.
'See all' link (ux-6): 42x16px text link is difficult to tap accurately on mobile.
Privacy Controls: Potential lack of clear feedback when toggling sensitive privacy settings.
Transaction Inputs: Validation logic for 'Send' amounts and addresses.
